Why go: easy-going sailing on Samui's sheltered south coast

King 5 is a sailing catamaran kept at a marina on Koh Samui's south coast, a short sail from Koh Tan and Koh Madsum (Pig Island). That location is its strength: the islands are close, the water is usually calm, and the south coast is sheltered from the north-east monsoon that makes the north side rough from October to December. Half days and sunset trips snorkel at Koh Tan and land at Pig Island; full days add a second swim stop and lunch.

The boat also does things most charter catamarans don't: a trolling trip for game fish, a night out squid fishing for two, and a simple overnight at anchor for up to four.

Who it suits, and who should choose something else

  • Good for: families, couples and groups up to 10 who want a relaxed sail rather than a fast boat.
  • Choose something else if you are staying in Chaweng or Bophut and want a short trip: the marina is on the south coast, a 30–50 minute drive away. The Pig Island speedboat tour includes hotel transfer.
  • Keen anglers: compare with the options in our fishing guide.

Good to know

  • Pig Island: the pigs roam the beach. Don't chase or lift them, and keep food out of reach.
  • Towels: not supplied; bring your own.
  • Overnight: meals are not included, so order the BBQ or bring food.
  • Weather: if the trip is cancelled for weather, you choose a new date or a full refund.

Choosing a trip

The half day is the sweet spot for families: two good stops and back by lunchtime. The sunset trip is short and calm. Choose the full day if you want a long lunch and more swimming time.
